sentences.en: I would like to go to the concert with you.
sentences.zh: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

sentences.en: The audience was immersed in an aftertaste of the concert.
sentences.zh: 观众沉浸在音乐会余韵中。

sentences.en: After the concert, the crowd made for the nearest door.
sentences.zh: 音乐会结束后，人群朝最近的门走去。

senses.zh: 制定计划；通过协商达成一致
